title: Restriction to a linear subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f:(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n\to\alpha$, and let $H$ be a linear subspace of $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$. The restriction of $f$ to $H$ is the function $H\to\alpha$ that sends each element of $H$ to its value under $f$.
